snippet.title: Mining Wizards Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Mining Wizards is an incremental mining game. Mine minerals, gather materials, upgrade a massive skill tree, level up, unlock talents, discover artifacts, and attract artifact visitors!

🎮 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4205900/Mining_Wizards/
